label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_01
text: I remember your olive-rolling prowess very\nwell, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_02
text: You had such vigor—it was almost as if you had\nTerastallized into a Fighting type yourself![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_03
text: How many Gyms had you been to when you first\ncame here to mine? Was it your first?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_04
text: The Cortondo Gym is close to the academy, so\nmany young Trainers just starting out like to come\r\nhere first.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_05
text: With that in mind, La Primera asks me to go soft\non Trainers—like a nice sponge cake.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_06
text: I feel sad for my sweet little bugs, though, since\nthat means they quite often lose their battles.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_07
text: Hehe. But opportunities like this get me excited\nbecause I can finally show my true skill.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_08
text: Allow me to knead you into submission![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_09
text: That was quite the battle. I must say that your\nskill rivals that of even La Primera.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_10
text: Ah! How sweet it is to battle without holding\nback—even if I end up losing![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_11
text: I am beginning to think that going too soft on\npeople may be no good for either party.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_12
text: My culinary teacher, Mr. Kofu, did tell me to put\nmore of myself into my baking, after all.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_13
text: I think I may try conducting battles in more of my\nown style from now on![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_14
text: If Trainers complain that the Cortondo Gym is\nsuddenly more difficult, I’ll just tell them that\r\nnot all pastries are sweet![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: common_2020_mushi_020_mushi_15
text: Good-bye for now. I hope to see you again\nsomeday![VAR 0x0114(0016)]
